name: @qf-jarvis/riya-candidate-evaluation-runner
description: QF Jarvis OFFLINE candidate evaluation BRIDGE (MVP-P2A.1). The missing execution step between a real model candidate and the two evaluation authorities: it schedules synthetic cases through an injected provider-neutral candidate port, turns what a run observably did into @qf-jarvis/model-evaluation CandidateObservations and @qf-jarvis/riya-quality-evaluation observations, and hands them over. It owns one synthetic adversarial case per mandatory red-team kind, a fail-closed observation extractor that blocks evidence rather than defaulting an unprovable fact to safe, a P10 candidate capture over the unchanged 72-fixture golden corpus, a BLINDED human-review bundle that carries no provider/model/size/price/speed field, an external-path-only bundle writer, and review ingest that enforces two DISTINCT human reviewers. It contains no provider SDK, no HTTP, no credential, no retry, no endpoint and no price table; every candidate it has run against is a deterministic fake. No production runtime imports it. It evaluates nothing itself, computes no composite score and authorizes no rollout.
